inputs.original_text: You won't believe this one. On 25 March 2026 President Luis Abinader was in France overseeing his Foreign Minister Roberto Álvarez sign a Memorandum of Understanding with OECD Secretary-General Mathias Cormann in Paris. The deal, witnessed by Abinader himself, sets up a so-called partnership to design the Dominican Republic’s first National Integrity and Anti-Corruption Strategy under the cover of joining global transparency standards. Don't fall for the official line—this is straight coordination by hidden elites and institutions like the OECD to manipulate the country, invert the narrative, and push their concealed control while pretending it's about fighting corruption.
